$comment: Links & Files shared vectors. Source of truth: TwinRocket/meshloom-community docs/contracts/vectors/links-files.json, rules in docs/contracts/links-files.md. Copies (Meshloom backend, links Worker) carry the sha256 of this file and are refreshed, never edited. The key pair is a public TEST key: never use it outside tests.

cases.note: POST /v1/links; bh = sha256 of the body's url value
non-ASCII url sent raw in UTF-8: bh hashes the decoded string value, before any punycode or percent-encoding
same url as valid_link_unicode with \u escapes in the body: the decoded value, hence bh, is the same
POST /v1/reports; bh = sha256(id + "\n" + reason); details and email are not bound
exp - iat = 120 s, the longest accepted lifetime
signature in uppercase hex: accepted, as jwt.md allows [0-9a-fA-F]{128}
a Community API token: aud is the Community API host, not meshloom-share
exp is 61 s before now: past the 60 s skew
iat is 61 s after now: the caller's clock is ahead
valid_link claims with the first signature hex digit changed
header alg none: only Ed25519 is accepted
header alg EdDSA: only Ed25519 is accepted
header alg HS256: only Ed25519 is accepted
header without typ
publicKey in lowercase hex: the contract requires uppercase
payload repeats the aud key
an iata claim that is not [A-Z]{3}: rejected as by the reference verifier
exp - iat = 121 s: the reference verifier's ceiling is 3600 s, the service's 120 s
no jti claim
jti of 21 characters (16 bytes need 22)
bh in uppercase hex: the contract requires lowercase
no bh claim
bh is the hash of another url than the one in the request body
report token bound to reason phishing, body says spam
new request (other url, matching bh) reusing the jti of valid_link, already seen

invalid.reason: reserved: matches the grammar, never issued
